item.title: 1997 Toyota 4Runner SR5 V6 4WD
item.description: This 1997 Toyota 4Runner SR5 was initially delivered to Gresham Toyota of Gresham, Oregon, and remained with its original owner for 28 years before being acquired by the seller in 2025. The truck shows 57k miles and is powered by a 3.4-liter 5VZ-FE V6 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.description: This 1996 Daihatsu Hijet S110 is a right-hand-drive fire truck that was acquired by the seller and imported to the US in April 2024. It is finished in red over gray cloth and has 12" steel wheels, checker plate trim, a bed rack with a rear jump seat, a spotlight, a radio, and a cabin heater.
